slides.title: 5 signs you and your partner go to bed together but not really

slides.heading: same bed, _different apps_
slides.text:
you used to talk before falling asleep

now you _send each other reels_ from 2 feet away

slides.heading: "night" happens _45 minutes_ before sleep
slides.top: you say goodnight, then _both keep scrolling_

slides.heading: one of you _always_ falls asleep first
slides.top: the other is still lit up _like a nightlight_
slides.text: and you both swear _you were about to put it down_

slides.heading: your best talks happen _over text_
slides.text:
nobody put the phone between you on purpose

it's just _always there_

slides.heading: someone has to _go first_
slides.top: the person who quits scrolling _first_ wins
slides.text:
so i set a bedtime lock. my apps _shut off at 11_

turns out it's hard to scroll alone. _we talk again_

slides.question: send this to the person next to you 👀 who falls asleep first?
lines: the app is locturne, it's on the App Store
